Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 100 now!
Synopsis :
Chandragupta helps Martand to win the competition proving himself to be efficient to take the throne after his father, Jagatjala. Meanwhile, Mura successfully manages to obtain the seal from the Chief’s wife by her talent. Chanakya helps Indrajalak to become the stable owner’s favourite by calming down a horse. Further, Martand shows his gratitude to Chandragupta and introduces him to Jagatjala. While Chanakya saves Chandragupta from Jagatjala’s question, he learns about Amatya’s entry in Paraspura kingdom.
